bug_fixed.issue: GET /api/customers/{id}/addresses returned 404 for customers without addresses field
bug_fixed.root_cause: MongoDB projection {'_id': 0, 'addresses': 1} returns empty dict {} when addresses field doesn't exist. Python 'if not {}' evaluates to True, causing false 404
bug_fixed.fix: Added 'id': 1 to projection to ensure non-empty result: {'_id': 0, 'id': 1, 'addresses': 1}
